articles.title: Bit2Me sets up specialized unit to help law enforcement track down crypto assets
articles.snippet: The unit formalizes past operations, building on 1.5 million euros in seized crypto the exchange processed in 2025 for agencies including Interpol and Europol.

articles.title: Hunter Biden debuts 'LAPTOP' memecoin targeting TRUMP holders
articles.snippet: LAPTOP debuts Wednesday on Base, with nearly a third of the supply set to be burned if a slate of political and market outcomes — including a Democratic win in 2028 — comes good.

articles.title: Polish prosecutors charge fifth suspect in a massive crypto probe
articles.snippet: BitBay became Zondacrypto in 2021. The exchange stopped trading in April after customers faced frozen withdrawals and estimated losses of at least $94 million.

articles.title: Polish prosecutors charge suspect in Zondacrypto probe, seek pretrial detention
articles.snippet: Polish prosecutors charged Romana Ż. with organized crime and misappropriation offenses involving $2.1 million in Zondacrypto user funds.

articles.title: US Police Fear Meta Glasses Are Watching Them Back: Report
articles.snippet: Memos from the NYPD to Homeland Security warn the devices could be used for covert filming inside jails and police facilities.
